mission: Wave D RETRY — Hardware failure simulation (read+test only)
scope: 3 critical hardware failure scenarios — verify graceful degradation

S1_receipt_printer_offline.title: Receipt printer offline (TCP fsockopen fail OR ESC/POS send_failed)

code_paths.behavior: printReceipt() catches `result.method === 'none'` → sets `this.printFailed = true` + calls reportPrinterFailure(displayNumber, err). The 'kiosk-print-receipt' DOM element gets `data-print-failed="true"` attribute (line 96) which flips the receipt zone display via scoped CSS.

3-tier fallback chain: (1) Electron bridge printReceipt → (2) Electron ESC/POS lines → (3) browser window.print(). Returns `{method: 'none', error: ...}` only when ALL 3 fail. PRINTER_RETRY_MAX retries the electron bridge before falling through (config in kioskHardware.js).
Global ID selector `#kiosk-print-receipt[data-print-failed="true"]` provides safety-net display:block + amber border + scroll. Works EVEN if Vue SFC scoped CSS fails to load. P-MEGA W7.B.

.kiosk-receipt-zone hidden by default (display:none); when data-print-failed="true" → display:block + 80vh scroll + bordered card. .kiosk-printer-fallback amber alert banner with large queue number (3.5rem) for staff to read across counter.
fsockopen with 2.0s connect timeout + stream_set_timeout(2). On failure returns false + sets lastError ('tcp_open_failed', 'tcp_write_partial', 'missing_host'). NEVER throws — always graceful.
openDrawer/print wraps transport->send in try/catch + returns structured array {success: false, error: ...}. NEVER throws. Audit log via BypassAuditLogger when printing.bypass.enabled.

i18n_keys.kiosk.confirmation.fallback_receipt_help: L'imprimante semble indisponible. Vous pouvez prendre une photo de ce ticket ou demander à un opérateur.

S1_receipt_printer_offline.a11y: role=status + aria-live=polite added on .kiosk-receipt-zone when printFailed=true (lines 98-99). Screen reader announces fallback state.
S1_receipt_printer_offline.degradation_strategy: RESILIENT — order is ALREADY confirmed (printReceipt fires post-payment-success). Printer failure NEVER blocks fiscal sealing, KDS broadcast, or cart reset. Customer sees queue number + on-screen receipt + amber 'go to counter' banner. Staff sees displayNumber in big font.
S1_receipt_printer_offline.ux_clarity: GOOD — explicit FR message, large queue number, amber color scheme, scroll for full receipt, ARIA live region.

S2_tpe_timeout.title: TPE (terminal de paiement) timeout / failure

code_paths.behavior: PAYMENT_BYPASS_MODE env flag (gate GATE_BYPASS_MODE_2026-05-08) — simulates 'approved' response when true. forbidden_environments=['production','prod','live'] enforced at boot via AppServiceProvider.
POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE env flag — when true, bypasses cash-drawer + TPE hardware presence checks. NF525 invariants (sequence + audit chain + composition_snapshot) PRESERVED.
RefuseToBoot exception in production if POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE != false. Triple-defense: env + boot + runtime.
[SUPERVISOR WAVE C Z1] Plan B: ALL kiosk payments route to counter (no TPE at kiosk in V1 Le Cayenne) — TPE timeout at kiosk is N/A because TPE is NOT wired to kiosk.

assertCashDrawerSessionOpenIfCashInvolved() returns early if simulation_hardware=true. CashDrawerSessionNotOpenException raised when CASH involved + no session in non-sim mode. Atomic — fiscal-seq allocation not started until guard passes.
Split payment also short-circuits cashSession lookup when simulating. CASH tranches still recorded (OrderPayment row + audit log) but no cash_movement (no physical drawer to reconcile against).
recordCashOrderMovement() downgrades strict→soft when simulation_hardware=true (line 481). Cash session lookup non-fatal — Logs warning instead of throwing.

S2_tpe_timeout.degradation_strategy: BYPASS MODE — In V1 Le Cayenne, TPE is NOT wired (kiosk routes to counter, POS uses simulation_hardware=true). PAYMENT_BYPASS_MODE simulates 'approved' TPE response so cashier sees no terminal error. Real-world TPE timeout (when physical TPE plugged) would surface via PaymentService catch-all but specific TPE driver class not yet present in V1 — see config/payment.php:66 ('le vrai driver TPE' = future work).
S2_tpe_timeout.ux_clarity: PARTIAL — No dedicated TPE-timeout user-facing message because the real driver isn't wired yet. Bypass mode shows 'approved' silently. Production boot guard prevents bypass in prod env (RuntimeException at boot).
gaps: No dedicated TPE_TIMEOUT exception class — falls back to generic PaymentException
No 'TPE timeout — retry / cash fallback' modal in pos-wizard.js (Vanilla JS) — would surface as generic XHR error toast
Real TPE driver not implemented yet (config comment 'le vrai driver TPE' line 66)
S2_tpe_timeout.verdict: HANDLED_FOR_V1_BYPASS — GAPS for production hardware drop-in

S3_cash_drawer_fail.title: Cash drawer fail to open (TCP send_failed OR no printer wired)

code_paths.behavior: open() endpoint validates printer_id, calls EscPosPrinterService::openDrawer, returns 200 on success, 422 on failure (NO 500). On success, writes TYPE_DRAWER_OPEN movement to audit chain via recordMovement (strict=false). On failure to find OPEN session → Log::warning 'forensic gap' but does NOT block hardware response.

openDrawer returns structured array — possible errors: 'invalid_branch' (branchId<=0), 'no_printer' (no Printer row with station=receipt), tcp_open_failed/tcp_write_partial (transport layer). All catch-all wrapped, NEVER throws.

AppServiceProvider binds NullPrinterTransport (instead of TcpPrinterTransport) when env=testing OR printing.bypass.enabled=true. NullPrinterTransport short-circuits send() to log + return true (skipped flag). No fsockopen attempt.

When simulation_hardware=true, the assertCashDrawerSessionOpenIfCashInvolved guard is skipped → CASH order proceeds without physical drawer. PaymentService::recordCashOrderMovement downgrades strict→soft. Cashier never blocked.

[Sprint 5B Z10-NEW-001 F-7] Every hardware drawer pop → TYPE_DRAWER_OPEN audit row (amount=0) on operator's OPEN session. Manager-mode drawer-test before shift = Log::warning 'forensic gap'. Throwable caught — forensic write NEVER blocks hardware response.

S3_cash_drawer_fail.i18n_keys: No dedicated FR string for drawer-open failure in fr.json (returns raw 422 JSON to frontend toast handler).
S3_cash_drawer_fail.degradation_strategy: RESILIENT — drawer failure NEVER cascades. (a) If simulation mode → endpoint not called; (b) if TCP fail → 422 returned, frontend can retry or surface toast, fiscal seq + audit chain unaffected; (c) NullPrinterTransport in test/bypass = always success. Forensic gap logged as warning, never blocks order completion.
S3_cash_drawer_fail.ux_clarity: GAP — frontend toast on 422 is generic 'erreur' (no specific 'tiroir-caisse n'a pas pu s'ouvrir' string). Cashier must check log to know cause.
gaps: No dedicated FR i18n string for 'drawer open failed' — frontend renders raw HTTP error
No automatic retry on TCP transport fail (frontend must trigger second open call manually)
Manager-mode drawer-test (no OPEN session) → audit row SKIPPED (forensic gap only logged, not chain-anchored)
S3_cash_drawer_fail.verdict: HANDLED — minor UX gap (no FR string for failure toast)

cross_scenario_observations.transport_unification: All hardware (printer + drawer) goes through PrinterTransportInterface — single abstraction. NullPrinterTransport vs TcpPrinterTransport swap is config-driven (printing.bypass.enabled).
cross_scenario_observations.bypass_production_guard: Triple-defense at boot: env flag → AppServiceProvider RuntimeException (lines 78-145) → runtime config check. PAYMENT_BYPASS + PRINTING_BYPASS + POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE all refuse production.
cross_scenario_observations.audit_chain_invariant: Hardware failure NEVER bypasses NF525 audit chain. Either: success → audit row written; bypass → BypassAuditLogger::printingBypassed() row written (forensic trail of bypass).
cross_scenario_observations.fiscal_seq_invariant: Hardware failure NEVER causes fiscal sequence gap. assertCashDrawerSessionOpenIfCashInvolved runs BEFORE fiscal alloc — order rejected atomically if guard fails.
cross_scenario_observations.ux_state_machine: Kiosk: orange amber banner on printer fail + queue number 3.5rem. POS: generic 422 toast on drawer fail (UX gap). TPE: bypass mode silent (UX gap for prod driver).
